functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support searching for products by item names and displaying detailed product information for 100% of valid queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide full functionality for searching and displaying product details.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate product information for 99.9% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct product information retrieval.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results and detailed product information in less than 500 milliseconds for up to 10,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search and retrieval, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process search queries and retrieve product information for a single request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive search interface with autocomplete suggestions for item names.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with a search feature, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform product searches and display detailed information for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to product search services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all product search queries and responses using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interactions with the system, requiring protection of data in transit.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support searching for doctors based on symptoms or predicted diseases and display relevant doctor information for 100% of valid queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide full functionality for searching and displaying doctor information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate doctor information for 99.9% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct doctor information retrieval.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results and detailed doctor information in less than 1 second for up to 5,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search and retrieval, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 150 MB of memory to process search queries and retrieve doctor information for a single request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive search interface with dropdown suggestions for symptoms or predicted diseases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with a search feature, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform doctor searches and display detailed information for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to doctor search services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all doctor search queries and responses using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interactions with the system, requiring protection of data in transit.
